answer: A paid job is never handed out whole. A bridge warden splits it into fragments and deals them to random workers on the knoll, split hidden till landing. A warden checks each fragment against the basalt master copy within an hour; a wrong fragment or silence is a broken span: claim dead, fee lost, shut out a week. An honest worker spends five cents on a fragment; a farm of 1,000 fakes spends $50 and must still finish 1,000 fragments of real work.
